title: Introduction to Model Deployment 🚀
description: Convert models to TorchScript and ONNX for production serving.

slides.title: From Research to Production 🏭
slides.content:
# Why Deploy?

A trained model needs to run in a production environment (web server, mobile app, edge device). Deployment often requires:
* **No Python overhead**.
* **Optimized inference** (faster, smaller).
* **Portability** across platforms.

PyTorch offers **TorchScript** (JIT) and export to **ONNX** (Open Neural Network Exchange).

slides.title: TorchScript: Tracing
slides.content: Convert a model to a TorchScript module via tracing.
slides.codeSnippet:
model = nn.Linear(10, 2).eval()
example = torch.randn(1, 10)
traced = torch.jit.trace(model, example)
torch.jit.save(traced, 'model.pt')
print('TorchScript model saved')
# Later, load with: model = torch.jit.load('model.pt')

quizData.question: What does `torch.jit.trace` do?

options.text: It records operations as a graph by running an example input
It moves the model to GPU

quizData.explanation: Tracing runs the model once and records the operations, creating a static graph.

slides.title: TorchScript: Scripting 📜
Exporting to ONNX
slides.content: Convert to ONNX format for use in other frameworks (TensorRT, Caffe2, etc.).
slides.codeSnippet:
model = nn.Linear(10, 2).eval()
example = torch.randn(1, 10)
torch.onnx.export(model, example, 'model.onnx', input_names=['input'], output_names=['output'])
print('ONNX model exported')

quizData.question: Why might you export to ONNX instead of using TorchScript directly?

options.text: ONNX allows interoperability with other frameworks and inference engines

quizData.explanation: ONNX is an open format supported by many runtimes (TensorRT, OpenVINO, etc.).

slides.title: Optimizing for Inference ⚡
slides.content:
## Quantization & Pruning

Beyond TorchScript, you can:
* **Quantize** (reduce weight precision to int8).
* **Prune** (remove unimportant connections).
* Use **torch.jit.optimize_for_inference**.

Tools: `torch.quantization`, `torch.nn.utils.prune`.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## TorchServe

PyTorch's native serving tool for deploying models at scale with REST endpoints. Built on TorchScript.
